desc.id: Peta fiksi Riverlands dengan tiga tempat yang bisa dipilih untuk kota: lahan pertanian datar di tepi sungai, bukit yang tidak jauh dari sana, dan hutan yang jauh dari sungai.

River site.note: Lesson's label. One line ran over the boat and the river, so split over two lines ("Lokasi" / "Sungai").

N.note: U for utara, as the lessons say ("U (utara)").

Farmland that sometimes floods.note: Lesson's legend label. Too wide for two lines in the key, so three lines ("Lahan pertanian" / "yang kadang" / "banjir") with line gap 24 instead of 26.

Fictional map of Riverlands with three p.back: A fictional map of Riverlands with three places that could be chosen for a town: flat farmland on the riverbank, a hill not far from there, and a forest far from the river.
